create_adam_round_quantizer: create an AdamRoundQuantizer instance with a config to perform AdamW-based quantization
get_optimizer_adamw: get the AdamW optimizer class from AdamRoundQuantizer for quantization training
get_scaler_amp: get a GradScaler for mixed precision training from AdamRoundQuantizer when AMP is enabled
scale_loss_backward: scale the loss and perform backward pass with optional GradScaler support in AdamRoundQuantizer
step_optimizer: step the optimizer and learning rate schedule with optional scaler update in AdamRoundQuantizer
